title: About (ja)
excerpt: 小林雄太：指揮者。第14回グイド・カンテッリ国際指揮者コンクール第2位受賞。第58回ブザンソン国際指揮者コンクール本選選出。
content:
English Japanese

小林雄太：指揮者

第14回グイド・カンテッリ国際指揮者コンクールにて第2位受賞。コンクール本選にてミラノ交響楽団（旧ミラノ・ジュゼッペ・ヴェルディ交響楽団）を指揮。第58回ブザンソン国際指揮者コンクール本選に選出。

給費奨学生として東京音楽大学指揮科に入学。これまでに指揮を広上淳一、田代俊文、増井信貴、下野竜也らの各氏に師事。ダニエーレ・アジマン、ボリス・ベルキン、故汐澤安彦、徳永二男の各氏による指揮公開マスタークラスを受講。

大学卒業と同時に、日本製鉄文化財団若手指揮者育成支援制度に合格。指揮研究員として、紀尾井ホール室内管弦楽団、読売日本交響楽団、東京フィルハーモニー交響楽団にて研鑽を積む。神奈川フィルハーモニー管弦楽団副指揮者、京都市ジュニアオーケストラ合奏指導者を歴任。

これまでに神奈川フィルハーモニー管弦楽団、横浜シンフォニエッタ、東京フィルハーモニー交響楽団、東京シティ・フィルハーモニック管弦楽団、東京佼成ウインドオーケストラ等を指揮。

オペラの分野では、日本オペラ振興会等のプロダクションに音楽スタッフとして参加。また、東京混声合唱団とも数多くの共演を重ね、文化庁主催の巡回公演を指揮するほか、山田和樹氏らの公演の合唱指揮者を務めた。テレビ朝日「題名のない音楽会」、テレビ神奈川「晴の輔・めろんのかなフィルふぃ～る」等のメディアや、別府アルゲリッチ音楽祭等の音楽祭にも出演。

今後、オーケストラ・アンサンブル金沢、パシフィックフィルハーモニア東京、日本フィルハーモニー交響楽団など各地のオーケストラのデビューも予定されている。

title: About
excerpt: Yuta Kobayashi (小林雄太) is a Japanese Conductor. He was awarded Second Prize at the 14th Guido Cantelli International Conducting Competition, where he conducted the Orchestra Sinfonica di Milano (formerly Orchestra Sinfonica di Milano Giuseppe Verdi) in the final round.
content:
English Japanese

Yuta Kobayashi is a Japanese Conductor.

Yuta Kobayashi was awarded Second Prize at the 14th Guido Cantelli International Conducting Competition, where he conducted the Orchestra Sinfonica di Milano (formerly Orchestra Sinfonica di Milano Giuseppe Verdi) in the final round. He was also selected for the final round in the 58th Besançon International Competition for Young Conductors.

Kobayashi entered the Conducting Department of Tokyo College of Music on scholarship. He studied conducting with Junichi Hirokami, Toshifumi Tashiro, Nobutaka Masui and Tatsuya Shimono. He participated in conducting master classes with
Boris Belkin, Daniele Agiman, Yasuhiko Shiozawa and Tsugio Tokunaga.

Upon graduating from university, he was selected for the Nippon Steel Arts Foundation’s Young Conductor Development Programme. As a conducting fellow, he furthered his training with the Kioi Hall Chamber Orchestra Tokyo, the Yomiuri Nippon Symphony Orchestra and the Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra.

He has served as an associate conductor of the Kanagawa Philharmonic Orchestra and as an ensemble instructor for the Kyoto City Junior Orchestra. He has conducted orchestras and ensembles including the Kanagawa Philharmonic Orchestra, Yokohama Sinfonietta, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra, Tokyo City Philharmonic Orchestra and Tokyo Kosei Wind Orchestra.

In the field of opera, Kobayashi has participated in productions by organisations including the Japan Opera Foundation as a member of the music staff. He has also collaborated extensively with the Tokyo Philharmonic Chorus, conducting its touring performances organised by the Agency for Cultural Affairs, Government of Japan, and serving as chorus master for performances conducted by Kazuki Yamada and others.

His media appearances include TV Asahi’s ‘Untitled Concert’ and Television Kanagawa’s ‘Harenosuke & Melon no Kanaphil Feel’. He has also appeared at major music festivals, including the Beppu Argerich Music Festival.

Upcoming engagements include debuts with Orchestra Ensemble Kanazawa, Pacific Philharmonia Tokyo and the Japan Philharmonic Orchestra.
